ja534:1.1: Ete haṃsā pakkamanti vakkaṅgā bhayameritā, (IV 424|16) harittaca hemavaṇṇa kāmaṃ Sumukha pakkama.
ja534:2.1: Ohāya maṃ ñātigaṇā ekaṃ pāsavasaṃ gataṃ anapekkhamānā gacchanti, kiṃ eko avahiyyasi.
ja534:3.1: Pat' eva patataṃ seṭṭha, n' atthi baddhe sahāyatā, mā anīghāya hāpesi, kāmaṃ Sumukha pakkamā 'ti.
ja534:4.1: Nāhaṃ dukkhapareto pi dhataraṭṭha tavaṃ jahe, jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ vā me tayā saddhiṃ bhavissati.
ja534:5.1: Nāhaṃ dukkhapareto pi dhataraṭṭha tavaṃ jahe. na maṃ anariyasaṃyutte kamme yojetum arahasi.
ja534:6.1: Sakumāro sakhā ty-asmi sacitte samite ṭhito, ñāto senāpati ty-āhaṃ haṃsānaṃ pavaruttama.
ja534:7.1: Kathaṃ ahaṃ vikattissaṃ ñātimajjhe ito gato, taṃ hitvā patataṃ seṭṭha kin te vakkhām' ito gato. idha pāṇaṃ cajissāmi, na anariyaṃ kattum ussahe ti.
ja534:8.1: Eso hi dhammo Sumukha yaṃ tvaṃ ariyapathe ṭhito yo bhattāraṃ sakhāram maṃ na paricattum ussahe.
ja534:9.1: Taṃ hi me pekkhamānassa bhayaṃ na tv-eva jāyati, adhigacchasi tvaṃ mayhaṃ evaṃbhūtassa jīvitan
ja534:10.1: ti. Icc-eva mantayantānaṃ ariyānaṃ ariyavattinaṃ daṇḍam ādāya nesādo āpadī turito bhusaṃ.
ja534:11.1: Tam āpatantaṃ disvāna Sumukho aparibrūhayi, aṭṭhāsi purato rañño haṃso vissāsayaṃ vyathaṃ.
ja534:12.1: Mā bhāyi patataṃ seṭṭha, na hi bhāyanti tādisā. ahaṃ yogaṃ payuñjissaṃ yuttaṃ dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ tena pariyāpadānena khippaṃ pāsā pamokkhasīti.
ja534:13.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā Sumukhassa subhāsitaṃ pahaṭṭhalomo nesādo añjali 'ssa paṇāmayi.
ja534:14.1: Na me sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā bhāsanto mānusiṃ dijo ariyaṃ bruvāno vakkaṅgo cajanto mānusiṃ giraṃ.
ja534:15.1: Kin nu t' āyaṃ dijo hoti. mutto baddhaṃ upāsayi, ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ eko avahiyyasīti.
ja534:16.1: Rājā me so dijāmittā, sanāpacc' assa kārayiṃ, tam āpade pariccattuṃ n' ussahe vihagādhipaṃ.
ja534:17.1: Mahāgaṇāya bhattā me mā eko vyasanaṃ agā, tathā taṃ samma nesāda: bhattāyaṃ, abhito rame ti.
ja534:18.1: Ariyavatt' asi vakkaṅga yo piṇḍam apacāyasi, cajāmite taṃ bhattāraṃ, gacchatu bho yathāsukhan ti.
ja534:19.1: Sace attappayogena ohito haṃsapakkhinaṃ patigaṇhāma te samma etaṃ abhayadakkhiṇaṃ.
ja534:20.1: Noce attappayogena ohito haṃsapakkhinaṃ anissaro muñcaṃ amhe theyyaṃ kayirāsi luddakā 'ti.
ja534:21.1: Yassa tvaṃ bhatako rañño kāmaṃ tass' eva pāpaya. tattha saṃyamāno rājā yathābhiññaṃ karissatīti g. ā.
ja534:22.1: Icc-eva vutto nesādo hemavaṇṇe harittace ubhohatthehi saṃgayha pañjare ajjhavodahi.
ja534:23.1: Te pañjaragate pakkhī ubho bhassaravaṇṇine Sumukhaṃ dhataratthañ ca luddo ādāya pakkamīti.
ja534:24.1: Hariyyamāno dhataraṭṭho Sumukhaṃ etad abravi: bāḷhaṃ bhāyāmi Sumukha sāmāya lakkhaṇūruyā asmākaṃ vadham aññāya ath' attānaṃ vadhissati.
ja534:25.1: Pākahaṃsā ca Sumukha Suhemā hemasuttacā koñcī samuddatīre va kapaṇā nūna rucchatīti.
ja534:26.1: Evaṃmahanto lokassa appameyyo mahāgaṇī ekitthim anusoceyya, na idaṃ paññavato-m-iva.
ja534:27.1: Vāto va gandham ādeti ubhayaṃ chekapāpakaṃ bālo āmakapakkaṃ va lolo andho va āmisaṃ.
ja534:28.1: Avinicchayaññū atthesu mando va paṭibhāsi maṃ, kiccākiccaṃ na jānāsi sampatto kālapariyāyaṃ
ja534:29.1: Aḍḍhummatto udīresi yo seyyā maññas' itthiyo, bahū sādhāraṇā h' etā soṇḍānaṃ va surāgharaṃ.
ja534:30.1: Māyā c' esā marīci ca soko rogo c' upaddavo, (II 330|19) kharā ca bandhanā c' etā maccupāso guhāsayo, tāsu yo vissase poso so naresu narādhamo ti.
ja534:31.1: Yaṃ vuddhehi upaññātaṃ ko taṃ ninditum arahati, mahābhūt' itthiyo nāma lokasmiṃ upapajjisuṃ.
ja534:32.1: Khiḍḍā paṇihitā tyāsu, ratī tyāsu patiṭṭhitā, bījāni tyāsu rūhanti yadidaṃ sattā pajāyare, tāsu ko nibbide poso pāṇaṃ āsajja pāṇibhi.
ja534:33.1: Tvam eva n' añño Sumukha thīnaṃ atthesu yuñjasi, tassa ty-ajja bhaye jāte bhītena jāyate mati.
ja534:34.1: Sabbo hi saṃsayaṃ patto bhayaṃ bhīru titikkhati, paṇḍitā ca mahantā no atthe yuñjanti duyyuje.
ja534:35.1: Etadatthāya rājāno sūram icchanti mantinaṃ paṭibāhati yaṃ sūro āpadaṃ attapariyāyaṃ.
ja534:36.1: Mā no ajja vikantiṃsu rañño sūdā mahānase, tathā hi vaṇṇo paṭṭānaṃ phalaṃ veḷuṃ va taṃ vadhi.
ja534:37.1: Mutto pi na icchi uḍḍetuṃ, sayaṃ bandhaṃ upāgami, so p' ajja saṃsayaṃ patto atthaṃ gaṇhāhi mā mukhan ti.
ja534:38.1: So tvaṃ yogaṃ payuñjassu yuttaṃ dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ, tava pariyāpadānena mama pāṇesanaṃ carā 'ti.
ja534:39.1: Mā bhāyi patataṃ seṭṭha, na hi bhāyanti tādisā, ahaṃ yogaṃ payuñjissaṃ yuttaṃ dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ, mama pariyāpapadānena khippaṃ pāsā pamokkhasīti.
ja534:40.1: So luddo haṃsakācena rājadvāraṃ upāgami, paṭivedetha maṃ rañño: dhataraṭṭh' āyam āgato
ja534:41.1: ti. Te disvā puññasaṃkāse ubho lakkhaññasammate khalu saññamāno rājā amacce ajjhabhāsatha:
ja534:42.1: Dettha luddassa vatthāni annapānañ ca bhojanaṃ, kāmaṃkaro hiraññ' assa yāvanto eva icchatīti.
ja534:43.1: Disvā luddaṃ pasannattaṃ Kāsirājā tadābravī: yad'āyaṃ samma Khemaka puṇṇā haṃsehi tiṭṭhati
ja534:44.1: Kathaṃ ruciṃ majjhagataṃ pāsahattho upāgami. okiṇṇaṃ ñātisaṃghehi nimajjhimaṃ kathaṃ gahīti.
ja534:45.1: Ajja me sattamā ratti ādānāni upāsato, padam etassa anvesaṃ appamatto bhavassito.
ja534:46.1: Ath' assa padaṃ addakkhiṃ carato ādanesanaṃ, tatthāhaṃ odahiṃ pāsaṃ, ev' etaṃ dijam aggahin ti.
ja534:47.1: Ludda dve ime sakuṇā, atha eko ti bhāsasi, cittan nu te vipariyatthaṃ ādu kin nu jigiṃsasīti.
ja534:48.1: Yassa lohitakā tālā tapaneyyanibhā subhā uraṃ saṃhacca tiṭṭhanti so me bandhaṃ upāgami.
ja534:49.1: Athāyaṃ bhassaro pakkhī abaddho baddham āturaṃ ariyaṃ bruvāno aṭṭhāsi cajanto mānusiṃ giran ti.
ja534:50.1: Atha kin nu dāni Sumukha hanū saṃhacca tiṭṭhasi adu me parisaṃ patto bhayā bhīto no bhāsasīti.
ja534:51.1: Nāhaṃ Kāsipati bhīto ogayha parisan tava, nāhaṃ bhayā na bhāsissaṃ vākyaṃ atthasmiṃ tādise ti.
ja534:52.1: Na te abhisaraṃ passe na rathe nāpi pattike nāssa cammaṃ vā kīṭaṃ vā vammine ca dhanuggahe
ja534:53.1: Na hiraññaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ vā nagaraṃ vā sumāpitaṃ otiṇṇaṃ parikhaṃ duggaṃ daḷham aṭṭālakkoṭṭhakaṃ yattha paviṭṭho Sumukha bhāyitabbaṃ na bhāyasīti.
ja534:54.1: Na me abhisaren' attho nagarena dhanena vā, apathena pathaṃ yāma antalikkhecarā mayaṃ.
ja534:55.1: Sutā ca paṇḍitā ty-amhā nipuṇā atthacintakā, bhāsem' atthavatiṃ vācaṃ sacce c' assa patiṭṭhito.
ja534:56.1: Kiñ ca tuyhaṃ asaccassa anariyassa karissati musāvadissa luddassa bhaṇitam pi subhāsitan
ja534:57.1: ti. Taṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vācanā imaṃ Khemiṃ akārayi, abhayañ ca tayā ghuṭṭhaṃ imāyo dasadhā disā.
ja534:58.1: Ogayha te pokkharaṇiṃ vippasannodakaṃ suciṃ pahūtaṃ cādanam tattha ahiṃsā c' ettha pakkhinaṃ.
ja534:59.1: Idaṃ sutvāna nigghosaṃ āgat' asmā tav' antike, te te baddh' asmā pāsena, etaṃ te bhāsitaṃ musā.
ja534:60.1: Musāvādaṃ purakkhatvā icchālobhañ ca pāpakaṃ ubho sandhiṃ atikkamma asātaṃ upapajjatīti.
ja534:61.1: Nāparajjhāma Sumukha, na pi lobhā vam aggahiṃ, sutā ca paṇḍitā ty-attha nipuṇā atthacintakā.
ja534:62.1: Appev' atthavatiṃ vācaṃ vyākareyyuṃ idhāgatā, tathā taṃ samma nesādo vutto Sumukha-m-aggahīti.
ja534:63.1: N' eva bhītā Kāsipati upanītasmiṃ jīvite, bhāsem' atthavatiṃ vācaṃ sampattā kālapariyāyaṃ.
ja534:64.1: Yo migena migaṃ hanti pakkhiṃ vā pana pakkhinā sutena vā sutaṃ kiṇe ki anariyataraṃ tato.
ja534:65.1: Yo ca ariyarudaṃ bhāse anariyadhamm' avassito ubho so dhaṃsate lokā idha c' eva parattha ca.
ja534:66.1: Na majjetha yasaṃ patto, na vyathe pattasaṃsayaṃ, vāyameth' eva kiccesu, saṃvare vivarāni ca.
ja534:67.1: Ye vaddhā abbhatikkantā sampattā kālapariyāyan idha dhammaṃ caritvāna ev' ete tidivaṃ gatā.
ja534:68.1: Idaṃ sutvā Kāsipati dhammam attani pālaya dhataraṭṭhañ ca muñcāhi haṃsānaṃ pavaruttaman ti.
ja534:69.1: Āharant' udakaṃ pajjaṃ āsanañ ca mahārahaṃ pañjarato pamokkhāmi dhataraṭṭhaṃ yasassinaṃ
ja534:70.1: Tañ ca senāpatiṃ dhiraṃ nipuṇaṃ atthacintakaṃ yo sukhe sukhito rañño dukkhite hoti dukkhito.
ja534:71.1: Etādiso kho arahati piṇḍam asnātu bhattuno yathāyaṃ Sumukho rañño pāṇasādhāraṇo sakhā ti.
ja534:72.1: Piṭṭhañ ca sabbasovaṇṇaṃ aṭṭhapādaṃ manoramaṃ maṭṭhaṃ kāsikavatthinaṃ dhataraṭṭho upāvisi.
ja534:73.1: Kocchañ ca sabbasovaṇṇaṃ veyyagghaparisibbitaṃ Sumukho ajja pāvekkhi dhataraṭṭhass' anantarā.
ja534:74.1: Tesaṃ kañcanapattehi puthū ādāya Kāsiyo haṃsānaṃ abhihāreyyuṃ aggarañño pavāsitan ti.
ja534:75.1: Disvā abhihaṭaṃ aggaṃ Kāsirājena pesitaṃ kusalo khattadhammānaṃ tato pucchi anantarā:
ja534:76.1: Kaccin nu bhoto kusalaṃ kacci bhoto anāmayaṃ, (IV 427|269 V 348|13) kacci raṭṭham idaṃ phītaṃ dhammena-m-anusissati.
ja534:77.1: Kusalaṃ c' eva me haṃsa atho haṃsa anāmayaṃ. atho raṭṭham idaṃ phītaṃ dhammena-m-anusissati. Kacci
ja534:78.1: bhoto amaccesu doso koci na vijjati, kaccin nu te tav' atthesu nāvakaṃkhanti jīvitaṃ.
ja534:79.1: Atho pi me amaccesu doso koci na vijjati, atho pi te mam' atthesu nāvakaṃkhanti jīvitaṃ.
ja534:80.1: Kacci te sādisī bhariyā assavā piyabhāṇinī puttarūpayasūpetā tava chandavasānugā.
ja534:81.1: Atho me sādisī bhariyā assavā piyabhāṇinī puttarūpayasūpetā mama chandavāsānugā.
ja534:82.1: Kacci raṭṭhaṃ anuppīḷaṃ akutociupaddavaṃ asāhasena dhammena samena-m-anusissati.
ja534:83.1: Atho raṭṭhaṃ anuppīḷaṃ akutociupaddavaṃ asāhasena dhammena samena-m-anusissati. Kacci
ja534:84.1: santo apacitā asanto parivajjitā, noce dhammaṃ niraṃkatvā adhammam anuvattasi.
ja534:85.1: Santo ca me apacitā asanto parivajjitā dhamme c' evānuvattāmi, adhammo me niraṃkato.
ja534:86.1: Kacci nānāgataṃ dīghaṃ samavekkhasi khattiya, kacci matto madanīye paralokaṃ na santasi.
ja534:87.1: N' ahaṃ anāgataṃ dīghaṃ samavekkhāmi pakkhima. ṭhito dasasu dhammesu paralokaṃ na santase:
ja534:88.1: Dānaṃ sīlaṃ pariccāgaṃ ajjavaṃ maddavaṃ tapaṃ akkodhaṃ avihiṃsañ ca khantiñ ca avirodhanaṃ
ja534:89.1: Icc-ete kusale dhamme ṭhite passāmi attani. tato me jāyate pīti somanassañ c' anappakaṃ.
ja534:90.1: Sumukho ca acintetvā vissaji pharusaṃ giraṃ bhāvadosam anaññāya asmāk'āyaṃ vihaṅgamo.
ja534:91.1: So kuddho pharusaṃ vācaṃ nicchāresi ayoniso yān' asmāsu na vijjanti, na idaṃ paññavatām ivā 'ti.
ja534:92.1: Atthi me taṃ atisāraṃ vegena manujādhipa dhataraṭṭhe ca baddhasmiṃ dukkham me vipulaṃ ahu.
ja534:93.1: Tvam pitā viya puttānaṃ bhūtānaṃ dharaṇī-r-iva asmākaṃ adhipannānaṃ khamassu rājakuñjarā 'ti.
ja534:94.1: Etan te anumodāma yaṃ bhāvaṃ na nigūhasi, khilaṃ pabhindasi pakkhi, ujuko si vihaṅgamā 'ti.
ja534:95.1: Yaṃ kiñci ratanaṃ atthi Kāsirājanivesane rajataṃ jātarūpañ ca muttā veḷuriyā bahū
ja534:96.1: Maṇayo saṃkhamuttañ ca vatthakaṃ haricandanaṃ ajinaṃ dantabhaṇḍañ ca lohaṃ kāḷāyasaṃ bahuṃ, etaṃ dadāmi vo vittaṃ, issaraṃ vissajāmi vo ti.
ja534:97.1: Addhā apacitā ty-amhā sakkatā ca rathesabha, dhammesu vattamānānaṃ tvaṃ no ācariyo bhava.
ja534:98.1: Ācariya samanuññātā tayā anumatā mayaṃ, taṃ padakkhiṇato katvā ñātī passem' Arindamā 'ti.
ja534:99.1: Sabbarattiṃ cintayitvā mantayitvā yathātathaṃ Kāsirājā anuññāsi haṃsānaṃ pavaruttaman
ja534:100.1: ti g. ā. Tato ratyā vivasane suriyuggamanam pati pekkhato Kāsirājassa bhavanā te vigāhisun
ja534:101.1: ti g. ā. Te aroge anuppatte disvāna parame dije keke ti-m-akaruṃ haṃsā, puthusaddo ajāyatha.
ja534:102.1: Te patītā pamuttena bhattunā bhattugāravā samantā parikariṃsu aṇḍajā laddhapaccayā.
ja534:103.1: Evaṃ mittavataṃ atthā sabbe honti padakkhiṇā haṃsā yathā dhataraṭṭhā ñātisaṃgham upāgamun ti.
